added_lines: facebookfacebook.com/tubbercurrycloonacooltwitter @tubbercloona a prayer for our parish lord, watch over our parish, encouraging us to watch with one another as we seek to know your will. make us gentle in word, kind in spirit, strong in hope and guide us, ever gently along that road of peace that leads to your door; a door that will always open to the knock of faithful people. amen. on these two ……. love of god and love of neighbour, the lord tells us are the foundation of faith, the launch pad for the commandments and at the heart of christian life. during the week i was in cloonacool school and walked into a classroom where the teacher was discussing the parables with the boys and girls. “you couldn’t have come at a better time”, he told me. we had a short but meaningful discussion about why jesus spoke in parables. i asked the boys and girls to name some of the parables and, to their credit, they named many. amongst them was “the good samaritan”, which is truly a story about love of god and neighbour. jesus deliberately chose a samaritan to be the hero of the story because many of those to whom he was speaking saw no good in samaria or its people. to place one of them at the centre of the story, in an act of kindness and selflessness was jesus’ way of saying there is good in all of us and we need to let it shine. be a good neighbour this week. let us all strive to do well by one another. tubbercurry-cloonacool

you may support the parish through online donations via our diocesan website or by scanning the qr code tubbercurrycloonacool.com night prayer - each night at 10pm (approx.) join us on facebook.com/uinsionno eucharistic adoration there will be adoration in tubbercurry church each wednesday from 10.00am until 7.00pm and in cloonacool church on each thursday from 10.00am until 12noon. thank you for your commitment.

your prayers are asked for the late philip duffy , ballymote road; helen lynn , and formerly curry, sister of margaret o’hara, tubbercurry and paul carr , uncle of noreen gallagher, doomore. we remember all whose anniversaries occur at this time. may they rest in peace. november masses fr. vincent will say 12 masses during the month of november for the holy souls. there is an envelope in the offertory box for this, but if you do not get an offertory box and wish to have the deceased remembered during the month of november, there are envelopes on the table at the back of both churches. complete the form and return in the envelope provided. november remembrance service our annual remembrance service will take place on sunday november 22nd at 6.00pm in tubbercurry church. we will remember in prayer those who died between november 2025 and october 2026. families are invited to attend and all are welcome. we will have some light refreshments after the service. personal development the inner confidence personal development course with a coaching and well-being specialist will take place this november in tubbercurry frc. build greater self-trust, confidence, and emotional resilience. this is a four-week programme starting monday, 2nd november and costs €20. places are limited, bookings to

. praying the rosary a reminder that the rosary is prayed in tubbercurry parish church each monday, wednesday and friday before the 9.30am mass (beginning at 9.00am) and at 11.00am before the sunday 11.30am mass. all are welcome to join. recent baptism we welcome into the christian community ella rosie henry , coill dara who was baptised last weekend. one act drama festival the western drama festival one act festival takes place from thursday, 19th to saturday, 21st november in st. brigid’s hall. 3 nights – 9 plays. see

cloonacool players there are two sides to everything when it comes to cloonacool players in bruce adams’ hilarious farces – when i snap my fingers directed by eileen davey and mary directed by peadar conway, both to be staged pre-christmas. be prepared to laugh your socks off. alone – volunteers needed would you be willing to provide companionship through a weekly friendly visit to an older person who is seeking more social contact for just one hour per week? alone is currently seeking volunteers in the area. details on alone.ie/volunteers/ for more information please contact collette

thank you for your continued support – this makes a real difference in helping older people stay connected in their communities bereavement support group meets in the newman institute, ballina on the second wednesday of each month from october to may at 8pm. trained facilitators conduct the meetings, which provide guidance and support to all who find loss difficult. all are welcome. further details phone monica on
. scripture initiative dioceses of achonry and elphin 2026/2027 scripture initiative: new groups and facilitators are being sought. please consider. enquiries are welcome. see

atlantic care north west are currently recruiting. if you are available for part-time work and want to help make a big difference to the most vulnerable in the society give them a call. they are working closely with the hse to provide much needed care to seniors. phone

5 step su ppport service are you affected by the misuse of drugs or alcohol or drugs by another individual? 5 step support can help you. it is free, non-judgmental and one-to-one service. if you would like further information or an appointment, please contact

baby bonding course with tubbercurry frc starting 3rd november 10am-11am. suitable for parents, carers and babies from 28+ weeks of pregnancy to 8 months. €15 for the 6 week block. for more information and booking phone

. tubbercurry gaa healthy club join us every wednesday night from now until christmas for our wednesday night walks at kilcoyne park, tubbercurry, starting this wednesday, 28th october from 7.30pm. track is suitable for wheelchairs, buggies and prams. get the steps in, clear the heard and catch up with friends. why not join us for a cuppa afterwards. all are welcome. family carers support group will meet in tubbercurry frc on the second tuesday of each month at 11am, supported by family carers ireland. no one should have to care alone. join alvina your local support manager at this group, get to know others who are caring, learn about the range of services and supports available from family carers ireland. the sessions will be a safe and welcoming space to share and be heard. further information contact alvina

. solas café is a free non-clinical out of hours mental service for adults 18 years and over. open thursday to sunday, 5.00 pm-10.30pm in retreat house, charles street, sligo f91 rv0d. booking is essential on

anam cara parent support evening on the 4th tuesday of each month in the tf royal hotel, castlebar the next meeting will be tuesday evening at 7.30pm. event is free and open to all bereaved parents regardless of the age your child died, the circumstances of their death, or how recent their death was. you do not need to register in advance. for more details email

mayo stoma support group will have their next meeting on thursday at 7pm in the ellison hotel, castlebar. open to all who either have a stoma or those who care for them. text 6275776 to book a place. ct gaels best wishes to ct gaels for their game this sunday afternoon. all the way!
